findings.title: Draft content can be poisoned by a crafted seq value
findings.description: editor/autosave.ts:88 accepts a client-supplied seq without an upper bound. A seq near i64 max causes every subsequent legitimate autosave to be rejected as stale, effectively poisoning the draft for any future edit until the client discards and restarts.
findings.suggested_action: Bound seq to a clock-skew-tolerant window, or discard and restart the draft when the anomaly is detected.

findings.title: Approve endpoint accepts an unbounded seq with no authorization check
findings.description: editor/approve.ts:41 — the approve/merge path (named in PF-shipbar as a trust boundary requiring full rigor regardless of posture) has the same unbounded-seq shape as the finding above, but here it governs which draft version actually ships to readers, not just which autosave is accepted.
findings.suggested_action: Bound seq the same way, and add the missing authorization check before this path applies a merge.
